macros.name: DeclareCardType
macros.doc: This command defines a new macro \<name> (or raises an error if that command already exists). The new macro behaves exactly like the \Card macro, except that any key-value pairs you pass to the final argument of \DeclareCardType become the default values for cards created by the new macro.
